note: Nice article on creating swooping generative body lines that I've seen before. The idea is to create simplex noise points to give some spatial correlation, order they using a Hilbert order (overlay Hilbert curve and find index from spatial coordinates) then connect via a hobby curve. The Hilbert order isn't something I'd seen before but a nice application of the Hilbert curve to linearly order random points in 2d or 3d.
